title: Google Ads For Photographers: How My Business Grew 450%

facts.fact: The author states that her photography business was bringing in around $11,000 a year before she started Google Ads.
facts.quote: my photography business was bringing in around $11,000 a year (it was a rough start after moving cities)

facts.fact: The author reports that her income increased by about 55% in the first year she ran Google Ads, which she says was 2020.
facts.quote: The first year I ran Google Ads, my income increased by about 55%.

facts.fact: The author claims that over several years, using Google Ads helped her photography business grow by more than 450%.
facts.quote: Over the next several years, using Google Ads for photographers helped my business grow by more than 450%.

facts.fact: The page is dated 03.12.26 as its publication date.
